_note: Shortened example in the shape of an openFDA label record, for offline tests only.
indications_and_usage: Uses temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to headache, toothache, backache, menstrual cramps, the common cold, muscular aches, minor pain of arthritis; temporarily reduces fever
warnings: Warnings Allergy alert: Ibuprofen may cause a severe allergic reaction. Stomach bleeding warning: This product contains an NSAID, which may cause severe stomach bleeding.
ask_doctor_or_pharmacist: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are taking aspirin for heart attack or stroke, because ibuprofen may decrease this benefit of aspirin
dosage_and_administration: Directions do not take more than directed; adults and children 12 years and over: take 1 tablet every 4 to 6 hours while symptoms persist
